entry.title: HUSH ONE 0.2.8
entry.summary: Monophonic subtractive bass synth emulating the Roland SH-101. Port of the Schwung module **HUSH ONE** by charlesvestal to the MPC/Force plugin host, compiled unchanged from `charlesvestal/schwung-hush1` at `598ab90505f7` (`MIT`), linked with the mpc-vst-plugins VST2 wrapper and this repository's Schwung adapter `adapters/schwung/`. Gen1 build: armv7, glibc ≤ 2.29. ## Sources - module: https://github.com/charlesvestal/schwung-hush1/tree/598ab90505f7f924d09ed83f47e46430218cd43b - wrapper + skin g
